question: In a certain code language, STORMY is written as ABFIDG. How will LOTUS be written as in that language?
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7660753c807c8b80b82b5e8f9df32818750af16dd741ad7f069a426a87aba591.png] 

STORMY is written as ABFIDG.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2eba35631957e177ebfafe48c6f27cee528fd70911dbbe19ea301f4f6949bbd1.png] 

Similarly,

LOTUS will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8945bb7a66cfc7baee2c0f9ef5d2ec2c78e0a06f4e3042d8c11ab4176dd0d18.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"CFBCA".**
